text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instructions related to a development application for an ongoing appeal at the Ontario Land Tribunal (formerly the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal).

City Council on July 14, 15 and 16, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 6, 2021) from the City Solicitor as amended by motion 1 by Councillor Mike Layton. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 6, 2021) from the City Solicitor as amended by motion 1 by Councillor Mike Layton. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 6, 2021) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
